digest.component_or_area: store read surfaces (show, list, search, ready)
propositions: Every read CLI surface (show, list, search, ready) must produce parseable JSON output or exit nonzero when invoked during concurrent background write bursts via REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always

Exit code 0 implies stdout parses as the surface's documented JSON shape (object for show, array for list/search/ready); valid-empty serialization (e.g. []) passes while truncated/missing output fails
The reconverge throttle marker must be cleared before each parameterized read invocation to ensure every surface exercises the lock-contention path rather than short-circuiting to cached snapshots
Reads stalling indefinitely on the writer-held reconverge lock is the bug symptom; the fix bounds lock acquisition timeout to prevent empty-success output under storm conditions
